title: Standalone document expiry calendar
expected: Use the shared Jalali datetime input and store the selected aware expiry.
observed: The standalone upload used a browser-native Gregorian datetime field.

title: Employee document routes inherit MVP exposure
expected: The MVP exposure gate excludes full ESS document routes.
observed: The three routes inherited the shared MVP capability. The original unlinked actors were denied by domain authorization.

title: Contractual record creation returns HTTP 500
expected: Valid inputs create one draft through the existing contractual service.
observed: The ModelForm validated an incomplete record without its required project before the create service ran.

title: Exact contractual evidence retry duplicates the link and audit
expected: An identical actor, record, label and version retry retains one exact relation and audit.
observed: Two PostgreSQL connections submitting identical evidence created two durable links.

title: Contractual stale or invalid action lacks controlled feedback
expected: Invalid or stale actions preserve state and show understandable Persian feedback.
observed: Stale transitions raised unhandled validation errors. Invalid decision input redirected without feedback.

title: Standalone document forms display a hidden Treasury target
expected: Only MVP-exposed target fields are presented and selectable.
observed: The original Chrome forms rendered a Treasury Movement selector on both upload and detail.

title: Guarantee correction loses its inherited expiry date
expected: A blank optional expiry type inherits the approved predecessor type and date.
observed: The form sent an empty string. The correction lost the inherited date and failed validation.

title: Document detail omits a configured access deadline
expected: Display the configured deadline as a Jalali datetime to authorized readers.
observed: The original detail omitted the access deadline for an active document.
